text:
The photo shows a latte in a tall mug (about 12 oz) and a toasted English muffin on a small plate.

Latte, about 12 oz made with whole milk: roughly 180 kcal, 9 g protein, 14 g carbs, 9 g fat.
English muffin, toasted, possibly with a little butter: roughly 140 kcal, 5 g protein, 26 g carbs, 2 g fat. That is about 130 kcal for the muffin plus a bit of fat from toasting.

Served total is about 320 kcal. The photo is taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left. I assume the person eats nearly everything and leaves about 10 kcal.

Eaten is about 310 kcal. Scaling the macros down slightly gives about 13 g protein, 38 g carbs and 10 g fat.
